WITH input_payload AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF($1::text, '')::bigint AS conversation_id,
    NULLIF($2::text, '')::bigint AS lead_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, ''), 'text') AS message_type,
    NULLIF($4::text, '') AS text_body,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($5::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) AS raw_payload,
    NULLIF($6::text, '') AS response_kind
)
INSERT INTO messages (
  conversation_id,
  lead_id,
  direction,
  message_type,
  delivery_status,
  text_body,
  raw_payload
)
SELECT
  ip.conversation_id,
  ip.lead_id,
  'outgoing',
  ip.message_type,
  'queued',
  ip.text_body,
  ip.raw_payload
FROM input_payload ip
RETURNING
  id,
  conversation_id,
  lead_id,
  message_type,
  delivery_status,
  text_body,
  raw_payload,
  (SELECT response_kind FROM input_payload) AS response_kind;

WITH updated_message AS (
  UPDATE messages
  SET
    delivery_status = $2::text,
    external_message_id = COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, ''), external_message_id),
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = $1::bigint
  RETURNING *
),
audit_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_logs (
    event_name,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    actor_type,
    actor_id,
    result,
    before_payload,
    after_payload,
    metadata
  )
  SELECT
    $4::text,
    'message',
    um.id,
    'system',
    'n8n',
    $5::text,
    '{}'::jsonb,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($6::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb),
    COALESCE(NULLIF($7::text, '')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM updated_message um
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  um.id AS message_id,
  um.delivery_status,
  ai.id AS audit_id
FROM updated_message um
LEFT JOIN audit_insert ai ON TRUE;
